title: Wave 2 Person-by-Person 1 Chronicles (Jarha, Bithiah, Ephraim->Joshua, Reuben, 1 Chr 6 High Priests), Ginzberg Legends & Testaments of the 12 Patriarchs

nodes.name: Sheshan (Jerahmeelite Father of Ahlai, 1 Chr 2:34–35)
nodes.notes: Descended from Jerahmeel -> Onam -> Shammai -> Nadab -> Appaim -> Ishi -> Sheshan; wed his daughter Ahlai to his Egyptian servant Jarha.

nodes.name: Ahlai (Daughter of Sheshan; Wife of Jarha the Egyptian, 1 Chr 2:31, 35)
nodes.role: Judahite Heiress Wed to Jarha the Egyptian
nodes.notes: Daughter and heiress of Sheshan who married Jarha the Egyptian and bore Attai.

nodes.name: Jarha the Egyptian (Son-in-Law of Sheshan, 1 Chr 2:34–35)
nodes.role: Egyptian Grafted Into Tribe of Judah
nodes.notes: Egyptian servant freed and given Sheshan's daughter Ahlai in marriage, founding a 13-generation Judahite lineage.

nodes.name: Mered of Judah (Son of Ezrah; Husband of Pharaoh's Daughter Bithiah, 1 Chr 4:17–18)
nodes.role: Judahite Husband of Egyptian Princess Bithiah
nodes.notes: Son of Ezrah; married both a Judahite wife (Hodiah) and Pharaoh's daughter Bithiah.

nodes.name: Princess Bithiah (Daughter of Pharaoh; Wife of Mered, 1 Chr 4:18; Ginzberg II, 270)
nodes.role: Egyptian Princess Married Into Tribe of Judah
nodes.notes: Explicitly named in 1 Chr 4:18 as 'Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered married'; identified in Rabbinic tradition (Ginzberg II, 270; VII, 84) as Moses's adoptive mother!

nodes.name: Miriam (Daughter of Mered & Bithiah, 1 Chr 4:17)
nodes.notes: First named child of Bithiah in 1 Chr 4:17.

nodes.notes: Father of Maon and Eshtemoa.

nodes.notes: Founder of Eshtemoa.

nodes.name: Hur (Son of Caleb ben Hezron & Ephrath; Supported Moses's Hands, Exod 17:10; 1 Chr 2:19)
nodes.notes: Firstborn of Ephrath; father of Uri, Shobal, Salma, and Hareph.

nodes.name: Uri ben Hur (Father of Bezalel, Exod 31:2; 1 Chr 2:20)
nodes.notes: Father of Tabernacle architect Bezalel.

nodes.notes: Filled with the Spirit of God to craft the Ark and Tabernacle.

nodes.name: Salma ben Hur (Founder of Bethlehem & Kenite Scribes, 1 Chr 2:51, 54)
nodes.notes: Father of Bethlehem and Netophathites.

nodes.notes: Son of Jerahmeel & Atarah; grandfather of Appaim/Sheshan.

nodes.name: Helah & Naarah (Wives of Ashhur of Tekoa, 1 Chr 4:5–7)

nodes.name: Shaharaim (Benjamite in Moab + Hushim & Hodesh, 1 Chr 8:8–11; Myers p.155)
nodes.notes: Fathered 7 sons by Hodesh in Moab (Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam, Jeuz, Sachiah, Mirmah) and Abitub & Elpaal by Hushim.

nodes.name: Rotheus of Chaldea (Brother of Rebekah's Nurse Deborah; Father of Bilhah, T. Naph. 1:9–12)
nodes.era: Patriarchal Era (Testament of Naphtali 1:9–12; Ginzberg II, 209)
nodes.role: Chaldean Kinsman of Abraham & Father of Bilhah
sources: R.H. Charles APOT Vol. 2 / Testaments (charles2.pdf p.350)
nodes.notes: Testament of Naphtali 1:9–12 explicitly states: 'Bilhah, daughter of Rotheus the brother of Deborah, Rebecca's nurse... And Rotheus was of the family of Abraham, a Chaldean, God-fearing, free-born, and noble.'

nodes.name: Euna (Wife of Rotheus; Mother of Bilhah, T. Naph. 1:11–12)
nodes.notes: Wife of Rotheus (named Euna/Hannah in variants) who named her daughter Bilhah in Haran.

nodes.name: Deborah (Nurse of Rebekah & Sister of Rotheus, Gen 35:8; T. Naph. 1:9)
nodes.notes: Rebekah's lifelong nurse buried beneath the Oak of Weeping below Bethel.

nodes.name: Melcha (Daughter of Bathuel; Wife of Levi, Testament of Levi 11:1)
nodes.role: Matriarch of All Levites & Mother of Jochebed
nodes.notes: Testament of Levi 11:1 records: 'When I took a wife I was twenty-eight years old, and her name was Melcha' — bearing Gersam (Gershon), Kohath, Merari & Jochebed.

nodes.name: Hadurah / Hadorah (Wife of Malchiel / Asher; Mother of Serah, Ginzberg II, 39; Jasher 45)
nodes.role: Mother of Righteous Longevity Matriarch Serah bat Asher
nodes.notes: Widow of Malchiel who wed Asher and brought righteous Serah bat Asher into Jacob's household (Ginzberg II, 39, VII p.440).

nodes.name: Aridah (Daughter of Jobab; Wife of Issachar, Ginzberg Index p.61; Jasher 45)
nodes.era: Patriarchal Era (Jasher 45; Ginzberg VII Index p.61)
nodes.role: Wife of Issachar & Sister of Adinah
nodes.notes: Daughter of Jobab ben Joktan; younger sister of Levi's wife Adinah.

nodes.name: Noaba (Twin Daughter of Adam & Eve, Pseudo-Philo I.1)
nodes.notes: Named twin sister/daughter alongside Cain in Pseudo-Philo.

nodes.name: Themech (Wife of Cain, Pseudo-Philo II.1)
nodes.notes: Named wife of Cain in Pseudo-Philo Ch. 2.

nodes.name: Judge Kenaz (57-Year First Judge in Pseudo-Philo Ch. 25–28)
nodes.role: First Judge of Israel in Pseudo-Philo
nodes.notes: Father of Othniel & uncle/brother in Caleb's Kenizzite house.

nodes.name: Judge Zebul (Successor of Kenaz, Pseudo-Philo Ch. 29)
nodes.notes: Succeeded Kenaz and established a sacred treasury at Shiloh.

nodes.name: Eluma bat Remac (Mother of Judge Samson, Pseudo-Philo Ch. 42)
nodes.role: Mother of Samson Named in Pseudo-Philo
nodes.notes: Named wife of Manoah of Zorah in Pseudo-Philo.
